correctness.rationale: Exact all-length proof via the 24-state positional permutation action R=(abc), S=(abcd), group identity closure, and degree equal to cyclic 00 count. Exhaustive small permutation-product residue tables classify all deficits <=8 and match constructive identity controls. Stars-and-bars with marked switch runs gives all extremizer multiplicities, with a separate n=8 all-switch case. A 48-state weighted trace counts every degree. verify.py checks finite group cases and independent direct colorings through length 15, group products through 18, transfer trace through 12; these supplement rather than replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: Maximum local branching is a natural algorithmic measure in the 4-coloring reconfiguration graph of distance-two constrained cycles. Three sharp length-residue deficits and exact extremal counts are structurally unexpected and non-implied by frozen-state enumeration, and have a group-theoretic explanation. The theorem also computes every intermediate local degree via a finite exact transfer. This is a motivated all-length reconfiguration classification rather than an arbitrary small graph census.
